summary: Revalidates the browser entry document after an upgrade and opens verified workspaces while membership choices load.
userImpact: Sign-in and bookmarked workspace pages use the current application files after an upgrade.
A verified workspace no longer waits for the account menu's organization list.

changes: The authenticated profile includes the verified tenant slug when the request has an active tenant scope.

security: Application document revalidation preserves the existing security headers.
Workspace admission reuses the tenant scope verified by the server on the authenticated profile request.
documentation: The container frontend revalidates the application document and retains long-lived caching for content-addressed assets.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: The frontend delivery check verifies document revalidation and immutable caching for versioned assets.
A browser check delays the membership response and verifies that the current workspace opens with the correct header link.

customerDocumentation.reason: The correction restores the existing sign-in and deep-link behavior without changing user steps.
